5	## Finding
6	
7	``` text
8	head/.claude/adapters/loa_cheval/providers/agy_headless_adapter.py:125 — The opt-in refusal is raised from `complete()` as a plain ConfigError, so cheval's chain walker does not skip the hop. It takes the "non-retryable typed cheval error — surface immediately" arm (cheval.py:2545-2553) and aborts the whole invocation with INVALID_CONFIG. Every stock Google chain ends in `google:gemini-headless` (model-config.yaml:216-309). With the default (opt-in off), a Google call whose HTTP hops fail for a retryable reason (429/5xx) now ends as a non-retryable INVALID_CONFIG, which hides the real upstream exit code. Under `prefer-cli` the agy hop comes first, so the voice aborts before any HTTP hop is tried. This is the "failed voice instead of not planned" result FR-1 says it removes. The opt-in miss should be a walkable skip: record it in models_failed and `continue`. Alternatively, filter the hop out when the chain is built.
